text: iPhone port step 2c: screens and view models move to a shared multiplatform module

From T-351: ui/Strings.kt resolves Compose resources per locale via java.util.Locale and a brief Locale.setDefault around getSystemResourceEnvironment (cached per locale); common code needs a multiplatform replacement (ResourceEnvironment built from the app locale) when the screens move.

From T-350: CommonModules.kt (coreModule, viewModelModule) still names :app-only classes the view models use (NotificationPrefsStore, ThemePreferenceStore, UpdateChecker, ...); put interfaces in front of them when the modules move.
